info.title: LinkShift Management API (API Key Accessible Endpoints) — Domains
info.description:
Organization-scoped Management API for redirect configuration, link maps, and operational checks.
Use it to automate what you can also do in the LinkShift dashboard — without dashboard session cookies.

**Authentication**
- Send your key on every request: `X-API-Key: <your_key>` (preferred).
- Alternative header supported by the backend: `Authorization: ApiKey <your_key>`.

**Typical setup order**
1. Domain group → custom domains and/or LinkShift subdomains → redirect rules (and optional link maps).
2. Link map + entries when rules resolve keys instead of a fixed destination.
3. Redirect tests + simulate for CI; analytics for traffic review.

**Errors and recovery**
- `401` — key missing, revoked, or wrong organization. Create or rotate a key in the dashboard (Organization → API keys).
- `402` — API access isn't on your current plan. Upgrade subscription, then retry.
- `429` — per-key rate limit for your plan. Back off with jitter; read current usage via GET /api/v1/organization/usage (don't hard-code limits).
- `400` — request body or query failed validation; inspect `details` and `requestId` in the JSON body.
- `404` — ID doesn't exist or isn't in your organization scope.

**Dashboard-only**
API key CRUD, billing checkout, and some analytics views aren't in this spec — they require signed-in dashboard auth.

**Guides** (same concepts, more examples): *Getting started*, *Domains and groups*, *Redirect rules*, *Redirect rules — operations*, *Link map entries*.
This document contains only operations tagged "Domains".
Tag scope: Your custom hostnames assigned to a domain group.
Create after the group exists; rules match traffic on these hosts.

New domains start with `dnsStatus: PENDING` until DNS points at the LinkShift target IP
(`APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_IP`). Call POST `/api/v1/domains/{id}/verify-dns` to check manually, or
let the edge probe succeed on first HTTPS traffic.

**Internal (not in this spec):** Caddy calls `GET /check-domain?domain={hostname}` before
on-demand TLS for custom domains. That endpoint returns **403** when the hostname is unknown,
the domain group is inactive, or DNS is not verified yet (`dns_pending`). LinkShift subdomains
(`*.linkshift.app`) skip DNS verification (wildcard TLS).

get.description:
Returns all active custom domains in one response (no cursor pagination).
Filter client-side by `domainGroupId` when you only need one group.

post.description:
Registers a custom hostname under `domainGroupId`.
Hostname must match the request pattern; it is stored in lowercase (mixed-case input is normalized).
The response includes `dnsStatus: PENDING` until DNS points at the LinkShift target IP and verification succeeds.
On-demand TLS (`GET /check-domain`, internal) is denied until DNS is verified.
Returns 404 when the group ID is invalid; 409 when the hostname is already registered
platform-wide (among active records), is reserved on the platform infrastructure,
or is in a 7-day release cooldown after a recent deletion (hostname reserved globally).

409.description: Hostname already registered platform-wide (active record), in a 7-day release cooldown after a recent deletion, or invalid after normalization. Cooldown `details` follow the pattern: `Domain name {hostname} was recently deleted and is in a 7-day release cooldown until {iso8601}`.

value.details: Domain name example.com was recently deleted and is in a 7-day release cooldown until 2026-07-04T12:00:00.000Z

get.description:
Fetches one domain record (`name`, `domainGroupId`, DNS verification fields, timestamps).
Returns 404 when the ID is unknown, soft-deleted, or outside your organization.

put.description:
Moves the domain to another group only. The hostname (`name`) is immutable after creation;
sending `name` in the body returns 400 (strict request schema).
To use a new hostname, delete this domain and create a new one (triggers a new TLS certificate for custom domains).
`domainGroupId` is required in the body.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes the domain. Published links on this hostname stop working immediately.
The hostname stays reserved globally for 7 days (release cooldown) before it can be created again.
Returns 404 when the ID isn't in your organization.

post.description:
Performs a live DNS lookup for the domain's hostname and updates `dnsStatus`,
`dnsVerifiedAt`, and `dnsLastCheckedAt`.

Resolves A records (following CNAME chains) and compares them to the platform target IP
(`APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_IP`). On success, sets `dnsStatus` to `VERIFIED` and clears the edge
`check-domain` gate for on-demand TLS. On failure, sets `dnsStatus` to `FAILED`.

Does not apply to LinkShift subdomains. Idempotent — safe to retry after DNS propagation.

200.description: Updated domain with DNS verification result

CreateDomainRequest.description: Payload for creating a domain. Hostnames are stored in lowercase.

name.description: Fully qualified domain name (DNS hostname labels). The API accepts mixed-case input and normalizes to lowercase before persistence; the pattern below is the stored form.

Domain.description:
Domain entity assigned to a domain group.
Custom domains start with `dnsStatus: PENDING` on create. TLS and redirect routing on the
edge require verified DNS (`VERIFIED`) unless the edge probe succeeds during `check-domain`.

dnsVerifiedAt.description: UTC timestamp when DNS last verified successfully (null until first success).

dnsLastCheckedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent DNS verification attempt.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp in UTC when deleted.

ErrorResponse.description:
Standard error envelope. Use `key` for branching in code, `details` for human-readable fixes,
and `requestId` when escalating to support.

requestId.description: Correlation ID useful for support and troubleshooting.

feature.description: Optional feature gate identifier when relevant (for example `api_access`).

UpdateDomainRequest.description: Payload for updating a domain. Only `domainGroupId` is accepted; hostname is immutable (sending `name` returns 400).

QueryResultMeta.description: Metadata envelope shared by cursor-paginated query responses.

dataType.description: Logical item type in the `data` array.

hasMore.description: Whether there are additional results after this page.

moreStartingAfterId.description: Cursor token to request the next page.

DomainDnsStatus.description:
DNS verification state for custom domains. LinkShift subdomains do not use this field.
`PENDING` — created but DNS not yet confirmed; edge TLS blocked via internal `check-domain`.
`VERIFIED` — A record (or CNAME chain) points at the LinkShift target IP.
`FAILED` — last manual or automatic check did not find the target IP.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key. Verify the `X-API-Key` header and that the key wasn't revoked in the dashboard; rotate if needed, then retry.

PaymentRequired.description: API access isn't enabled on your subscription (`feature` is often `api_access`). Upgrade the plan in the dashboard, then retry with the same key.

value.details: API key usage is available on paid plans only. Upgrade your subscription to use API access.

TooManyRequests.description: Per-key rate limit for your plan. Back off exponentially with jitter; avoid tight retry loops. Check GET organization/usage for current inventory (limits are plan-defined, not returned here).

NotFound.description: Resource ID doesn't exist, was soft-deleted, or isn't in your organization. Confirm the ID from a fresh list call and that you're using the correct API key.

BadRequest.description: Request body or query failed validation. Read `details` (and optional field hints) in the JSON body; fix the payload and retry. Include `requestId` when contacting support.

EntityId.name: id
EntityId.description: Resource ID from a prior list or create response (same string you store in automation state). Wrong or foreign-org IDs return 404.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description:
Organization API key from the dashboard (Organization → API keys).
Send via `X-API-Key` on every request in this spec.
